_doc: Art generated with Gemini (see docs/design/ART_BIBLE.md). Scenes come from the level data (tools/art/export-scenes.ts) plus the notes below; poses, schools and map are listed here. Run via .github/workflows/art-assets.yml. Output lands in public/art/ and is listed in public/art/manifest.json; the game falls back to bundled art for anything missing.

hotspot_objects._doc: How an abstract hotspot label becomes something visible in the picture. First matching keyword wins (lowercase); otherwise the region decides (upper = wall/board display, lower = students at desks, middle = a teacher or a shelf).

walk.prompt: Side view facing right, walking cycle frame {n} of 6: {phase}. Same scale and baseline in every frame.
phases: right foot forward, left arm forward
left foot forward, right arm forward

walk-away.prompt: Back view, walking away from the viewer into the distance, frame {n} of 3: {phase}. Hair tuft visible from behind.

point.prompt: Three-quarter view, pointing with the right glove toward the upper right, friendly encouraging face.

think.prompt: Three-quarter view, thinking: one glove to his chin, eyes looking up, small thoughtful smile.

celebrate.prompt: Front view, celebrating: both gloves up, small jump, big smile, eyes closed happily.

affirm.prompt: Front view, affirming: a thumbs-up with the right glove, warm nod.

idle.prompt: Front view, relaxed idle stance, frame {n} of 2: {phase}.
phases: eyes closed in a blink, everything else identical

schools.prompt: A single small UAE school building shown in a gentle 3/4 isometric view from above, like a detailed diorama piece, isolated on a plain flat pure green (#00FF00) background with no ground beyond a small paved base. Sand and white facade, shaded walkway, a palm tree, {detail}. No text, no signs, no flags with writing.

worlds.1: lively windows with group tables visible, a busy feel
worlds.2: a small observatory-like dome with a magnifying-glass motif shaped into the roof
worlds.3: glass walls showing tablets glowing inside, solar panels on the roof
worlds.4: a covered courtyard with benches where pairs of students talk
worlds.5: a round auditorium wing with tall windows
worlds.6: several connected wings of different heights
worlds.7: an elegant academy building with columns and a small tower
worlds.8: a grand central school with a wide entrance plaza

map.prompt: A gentle 3/4 aerial painted map of a sunny UAE town district seen from high above: soft sand terrain, patches of green parks, palm trees, a calm blue creek, low buildings at the edges, and one winding empty road from the bottom left to the top centre with open plots along it where schools will be placed (leave those plots empty). Morning light, soft haze toward the top. No buildings on the road's plots, no text, no labels.
